query:

           (publisher, license_code, evidence_snapshot_ref, snapshot_sha256, scope_note,
            captured_at, allowed, kind, grantor, url_prefixes, reviewed_by)
         values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::text::date::timestamptz, false, 'permission', $1, $7,
                 null)
         returning id
